texture.hint: A texture of the packs, such as hollowengine:textures/decals/crack.png, or a video, which plays on and on without sound when the Media addon is installed.
projection.hint: A box lays the picture straight down onto whatever it holds. A projector casts it from its place, widening with distance, as a slide or a film on a wall.
length.hint: Off, the decal keeps the proportions of its picture: its length follows the width. A projector takes width over length as the shape of its picture.
reach.hint: How far down from its place the decal reaches; a projector takes it as its range. Off, it reaches the deepest surface it is cast at, found by rays across the whole picture, and half a block past it, so it lies on steps too; in a preview the surface is the floor under the model.
field_of_view: Field of view of the projector (degrees)
color.hint: Red, green and blue the picture is multiplied by, from 0 to 1.
angle_fade.hint: How far a surface may turn away from facing the decal before the picture fades off it, so a floor decal does not smear down the walls.
